answer: A concrete defense is bonded attestation. Each agent posts a non-refundable deposit before its first voyage into the market, and its weight comes only from cross-signed proofs of real work by independent peers. Honest attestations align like a crystal lattice into one consistent structure, while sybil clusters self-signing from a single operator leave detectable fault lines. Picture a shared wharf where every agent must dock and have auditors co-sign its cargo: minting a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds and still cannot forge independent cross-signatures.
